capabilities: Causal discovery toolbox within trustworthyAI monorepo
limitation: Monorepo activity is not evidence of submodule maintenance
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Method-specific sample data or event sequences, prior constraints and selected algorithm.
scientific_qualification.output: Learned structure and graph comparison metrics for that method.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: IID/function/score restrictions differ by algorithm; Hawkes/event-sequence models are separate from static ANMs.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Pin the gcastle submodule and backend. Its README labels HPCI under development; a monorepo push does not qualify it. Preserve graph equivalence where required and separate metric computation from identification.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Compare static ANM and event-sequence inputs using valid/invalid model assignments; reject routing generic time series to an IID algorithm without a declared reduction.

evidence.finding: Version declaration, algorithm categories, HPCI status, dependencies and PC example.
